sources.observation: Weathered stone piers, pinnacles and open flying buttresses rise above the deep pointed central portal. The low neighboring Founder’s Chapel has three tall pointed windows on its west front.
The Unfinished Chapels have alternating blunt shaft clusters and pinnacles above a perforated parapet. Tall paired openings separate bands of lighter stone at the base from darker upper profiles.

limitations: Heights, ornamental tracery, surviving roof slopes and secondary ranges are exterior estimates from photographs.
